claims.text: The hotel sits at the edge of Lake Leman, with views of the Jet d'Eau and Mont Blanc.

findings.quote: Elegantly poised at the edge of Lake Leman with magnificent views of the famous Jet d’Eau and Mont Blanc

claims.text: The hotel's address is Quai du Mont-Blanc 17, Geneva.

findings.quote: Quai du Mont-Blanc 17, Geneva, Switzerland

claims.text: A short boat ride connects the hotel to the city centre, with the Flower Clock, the Old Town and the Patek Philippe Museum.

findings.quote: A short boat ride connects you to the city centre, where you can admire the famous Flower Clock, wander through the Old Town, or visit the remarkable Patek Philippe Museum.

claims.text: In 1960 the hotel was acknowledged as one of the heritage sites of the city of Geneva.

findings.quote:
1960

Hotel d'Angleterre was acknowledged as one of the heritage sites of the city of Geneva.

claims.text: Rooms and suites are individually styled, with art, elegant furnishings and marble-lined bathrooms.

findings.quote: Hotel d'Angleterre offers a range of sumptuous, individually styled rooms and suites, all bedecked in exquisite art and elegant furnishings and complemented by marble-lined bathrooms.

claims.text: Rooms have Savoir beds with Swiss quality Elite mattresses and evening turndown.

findings.quote:
Savoir Beds and Swiss quality Elite mattress
- Evening turndown

claims.text: Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga leads the hotel's culinary offering.

findings.quote: Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga and his talented team lead a diverse culinary offering throughout the hotel

claims.text: The cellar holds over 225 bins, with a wine list created by Master Sommelier Julien Meurillon.

findings.quote: With over 225 bins in our cellar, Julien Meurillon, our Master Sommelier has created an elegant and stylish wine list

claims.text: The traditional afternoon tea includes scones with Gruyeres double cream and homemade jam.

findings.quote:
### Traditional Afternoon Tea

Enjoy a selection of finger sandwiches; scones (plain, raisin and chocolate) with Gruyeres double cream and homemade jam

claims.text: The Leopard Bar offers creative cocktails and live jazz sessions from local bands.

findings.quote: With its vibrant atmosphere, creative cocktails, and live jazz sessions from top local bands, it's the perfect place to unwind.

claims.text: The Leopard Bar drinks menu features over 50 whiskies.

findings.quote: Our extensive drinks menu features fine wines, classic and innovative cocktails, and over 50 whiskies.

claims.text: The Leopard Bar serves fresh sushi and light bites.

findings.quote: Savour fresh sushi, tasty light bites, and expertly crafted cocktails at Leopard Bar.

claims.text: Guests can join Executive Chef Alexandre Cardiga at the Geneva Market to select ingredients.

findings.quote: Accompany our Executive Chef, Alexandre Cardiga, to the Geneva Market, where he will guide you through the process of selecting the finest ingredients.

claims.text: A make-your-own-watch experience takes place at the Initium Workshop in Geneva.

findings.quote:
### Make your own watch

Become a watchmaker for a day and leave with a truly unique timepiece. In the heart of Geneva, enter the Initium Workshop, where you will learn the fundamentals of watchmaking.

claims.text: The Cigar Lounge in the Leopard Bar has an air-flow extraction system in the floor and the ceiling's wooden panelling.

findings.quote: The exclusive Cigar Lounge in our famous Leopard Bar
it boasts a cutting-edge air-flow extraction system in the floor and the ceiling’s wooden panelling, to ensure relaxation in total comfort.

claims.text: The hotel was built in 1872 with a facade designed by architect Anthony Krafft.

findings.quote: Built in 1872, the hotel is a true city landmark, with an impressive facade designed by celebrated architect Anthony Krafft.

claims.text: Le 17 Restaurant has panoramic views across Lake Leman towards Mont Blanc, with cooking shaped by fire and seasonality.

findings.quote: Panoramic views extend across Lake Léman towards Mont Blanc at Le 17 Restaurant, forming a striking backdrop to a dining experience shaped by fire and seasonality.

claims.text: The private Tea on Lake Geneva boat cruise is available from June to September.

findings.quote:
### Tea on Lake Geneva

Step aboard a 'Bow Rider' boat for a private cruise on Lake Geneva.
Available from June to September.

claims.text: The lake fishing experience runs from May to September, depending on weather.

findings.quote: Join a seasoned local Swiss fisherman on Lake Leman for a three-hour fishing tour
Subject to availability, from May to September, depending on weather conditions.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime location.
